init.title: SaySo options
init.description: Adjust the engine: model, timeout, CPU and context settings, interaction trace retention and export, grammar-constrained tool calls, and duck volume. Conversation agents are configured separately.

data_description.model: Choose a published SaySo model (downloaded and checksum-verified) or a .gguf file in /config/sayso/models; you can also type a path.
data_description.grammar_decoding: Constrains model output to the tool-call syntax SaySo parses, so malformed calls are not generated. Applies only when Home Assistant tools are sent. Experimental; off by default.
data_description.duck_volume: Media players in the satellite's area are lowered to this volume while it listens. Players without a volume level are paused if playing, otherwise muted.
data_description.trace_export: Off by default. JSON Lines appends each stored trace to sayso_traces.jsonl in the Home Assistant config folder, rotated once at 10 MB. OTLP/HTTP posts each stored trace to the endpoint below.
data_description.trace_export_endpoint: Base URL of an OpenTelemetry collector, for example http://collector:4318. Required for OTLP/HTTP; only stored, redacted trace records are sent.
